:::{#exm-kronecker-delta}
#### Evaluating the Kronecker delta

- $$
  \begin{aligned}
  \kron_{11} &= [1 = 1] \\
  &= 1.
  \end{aligned}
  $$

- $$
  \begin{aligned}
  \kron_{12} &= [1 = 2] \\
  &= 0.
  \end{aligned}
  $$

- $$
  \begin{aligned}
  \kron_{22} &= [2 = 2] \\
  &= 1.
  \end{aligned}
  $$

- $$
  \begin{aligned}
  \kron_{23} &= [2 = 3] \\
  &= 0.
  \end{aligned}
  $$

:::
